hypothesis: With every other recipe factor fixed (60-day cache, width 40, 9000 steps, seed 11, batch 32, lr 1e-4), the label transform alone (raw official vwap_return vs the full-timestamp training-mean centered label vs the CSZ z-score+variance-matched label) changes out-of-sample ranking quality on the raw official labels. The round compares RAW, CENTER and the frozen CSZ baseline on identical keys, dates and labels, and decides whether a candidate earns a seed-29 replication.
preregistration_note: This file is written before the replay metrics of this round are computed. The decision framework below is fixed here; results are written to ../modified_tlob/label_contrast_20261024.json afterwards.

windows.name: july2023
windows.label: 2023-07-25..28 context window (before every version's training window; not part of the decision)

analysis.label_use: every version is scored against the same raw official vwap_return target values; model scores are used exactly as the saved weights predict them (score = network output * raw-label training std); no label inverse transform is applied to any version, and the centered/CSZ arms are not re-centred at evaluation time

style_residualization.exposure_snapshot: most recent exposure date strictly before the signal date; all eight timestamps of a day use that same snapshot; same-day rows never used; no forward fill; stocks without a previous-day exposure row are dropped from that timestamp for every version
style_residualization.winsorize: per timestamp clip at median +/- 3 * 1.4826 * MAD; MAD==0 falls back to population std; constant section becomes zeros
style_residualization.regression: equal-weight OLS without intercept on the 10 style factors + all 32 industry dummies; ret/weights/float_market_cap/industry_level1_code excluded
style_residualization.raw_reference: the raw-score metrics are also recomputed on the same exposure-common sample (raw_common) so the processed-vs-raw contrast is sample-identical

analysis.training_losses: read from runs/label-contrast-20261024/training_evidence.json for raw/center and from the frozen CSZ run archive; losses are listed per arm with their declared units and are never compared across arms

decision_framework.primary_metric: rank_ic_mean computed on the raw official labels (score used as predicted, no inverse transform)
decision_framework.primary_sample: the three development months pooled (nov2023 + jan2024 + mar2024 = 65 trading days); july2023 is context only and is not used for the decision
decision_framework.primary_test: paired daily rank_ic difference (candidate minus v2_60d_csz) over the pooled development months; contiguous-day moving-block bootstrap with block_days 5 and 2, 20000 draws, seed 20261024, 95% intervals
decision_framework.rank_ic_improvement: mean paired rank_ic delta > 0 AND lower bound of the block-5 95% interval > 0 AND lower bound of the block-2 95% interval > 0 AND the per-month mean delta is positive in at least 2 of the 3 development months

guardrails.long_short: material degradation only if the pooled mean paired daily long_short_return delta < 0 AND the block-5 95% interval upper bound < 0
guardrails.turnover: material degradation if candidate turnover_mean is more than 10% above the CSZ turnover_mean on the pooled development months (relative increase > 0.10)
guardrails.worst_day: material degradation if the candidate's worst single-day long_short_return over the pooled development months is more than 25% worse than CSZ's, i.e. (candidate_worst - csz_worst) / abs(csz_worst) < -0.25

verdicts.better_than_csz: rank_ic_improvement holds and no guardrail is materially degraded
verdicts.guardrail_degraded: rank_ic_improvement holds but at least one guardrail is materially degraded

decision_framework.seed29_followup: triggered for a candidate whose verdict is better_than_csz, or whose pooled mean rank_ic delta is > 0 with no material guardrail degradation and block-5 lower bound > -0.005 (promising but not conclusive because only seed 11 exists); not triggered when the point estimate is not positive or a guardrail is materially degraded
decision_framework.style_view: the style-residualized view is reported as a robustness check only and does not override the pre-registered primary metric; a materially different conclusion under residualization is recorded as a disagreement, not used to re-select a winner
decision_framework.single_seed_note: seed 11 is the only seed for RAW/CENTER in this round; the decision framework therefore treats a single-seed win as a replication trigger, not as final promotion evidence

access_policy: july2023 and the three development months (nov2023, jan2024, mar2024) only; final/locked ranges are never read; no model is trained or refitted in this round
